study.question: Does a fixed 0.2 product-channel gradient scale recover the normalized aligned model advantage, with and without tangent projection, or is event-dependent inverse-norm scaling still consequential? Observations: static/pooling/DIN AUC = 0.6050036145/0.6102261137/0.6133619861. Full normalized aligned = 0.6149816912, detached = 0.6145833321, tangent = 0.6140637917, identity = 0.6135629924, all seed 42. Full-minus-tangent AUC = +0.0009178995; full-minus-detached = +0.0003983591; AUC interaction = -0.0001024403. Existing factorization changes both event adaptivity and typical backward magnitude (ordered inverse-norm means 0.18416 and 0.19659). No positive synergy or semantic relevance follows. Count-correction and half-strength DIN failed to improve DIN; half pooling remained below DIN. Crossed controls were worse. Round-4 replays repeated earlier scores exactly, while adapter ordinary versus historical baseline drift remains a separate source-family issue. All 25 indexed model jobs succeeded operationally; unfavorable outcomes are scientific negatives, not execution failures.
study.hypothesis: A substantial part of the inverse-norm backward advantage can be explained by changing the magnitude of the explicit product-channel gradient relative to the other shared-embedding routes. Replacing 1/r by the fixed scalar c=0.2 should improve tangent-only and identity-only AUC toward the full and detached references respectively while preserving identical unit forwards. This tests a local optimization alternative; it neither predicts better semantic event relevance nor presupposes that the candidate beats the incumbent.

nearest_work.difference: Immediate local sources expose full=(I-uu^T)/r, detached=I/r, tangent=I-uu^T, identity=I above the common floor. New variants replace adaptive inverse scale with the single prespecified constant 0.2, retaining/removing projection. No broader novelty claim.

nearest_work.source_ref: https://arxiv.org/html/1911.07013v1 sections 3.2-3.3, Theorem 1 (Xu et al., Understanding and Improving Layer Normalization, NeurIPS 2019); primary full text read in this context
nearest_work.difference: Inherits the forward-matched derivative intervention principle of DetachNorm. This study uses L2-normalized field interaction vectors and fixed product-channel surrogate scales, without LayerNorm centering, affine parameters or a claim to reproduce their task results.

nearest_work.source_ref: https://arxiv.org/pdf/1706.05350 v1 sections 3 and 5.3 (van Laarhoven, L2 Regularization versus Batch and Weight Normalization, 2017); primary sections read in this context
nearest_work.difference: Provides a nearest optimization alternative involving normalization, weight scale and effective updates under Adam. Here scaling affects one route into shared field embeddings, so its parameter-scaling derivation does not automatically transfer.

nearest_work.source_ref: https://arxiv.org/html/1706.06978v4 section 4.3 (Zhou et al., Deep Interest Network, KDD 2018); primary text read in this context
nearest_work.difference: Inherits target-dependent attention and embedding/MLP design. The host reference is a category/brand/action/time adaptation with masked softmax, whereas DIN section 4.3 relaxes weight-sum normalization. We retain the benchmark adaptation and alter only the explicit aligned-product backward route. Field-aware interaction priority and exhaustive novelty remain unverified.

study.proposed_difference: Two standalone, capacity-matched surrogate-gradient modules: constant_tangent J=0.2*(I-uu^T), and constant_identity J=0.2*I for sum(p^2)>=1e-6, p=qc*hc+qb*hb and u=p/sqrt(max(sum(p^2),1e-6)). Both retain J=1000*I strictly below the floor and the common unit forward. The tangent rule uses detached 0.2*r multiplying u; the identity rule uses detached 0.2 multiplying p; a parenthesized zero-forward correction installs each surrogate. No scalar sweep, calibration, new features, trainable capacity, state, optimizer or loss. A single byte-identical incumbent bridge uses candidate.py to check contemporary end-to-end reproducibility/cost. Existing full/detached/tangent/identity seed-42 receipts are matched historical controls with checked source/config identities; bridge discrepancy forbids silently pooling incompatible executions. This authorized propose phase supersedes older memory advice to do repetitions only because the current runtime explicitly requests a feasible candidate with 1-4 variants; seeds remain frozen.
predictions: At fixed finite state all unit-forward products agree; shared constructor/encoding/scorer/classifier/mask methods and initialization consume the same RNG. Source-level VJPs should equal the declared matrices, including zero and small norms. Host tensor/autograd checks remain necessary before strong backward attribution.

If moderate product-channel attenuation explains some of the prior scaling advantage, constant_tangent exceeds r0007 tangent AUC and constant_identity exceeds r0007 identity AUC. Inspect constant_tangent versus full and constant_identity versus detached as replacements, reporting all deltas and Logloss tradeoffs rather than selecting a favorable contrast.

Projection under fixed scale is measured by constant_tangent minus constant_identity; compare it with full minus detached under adaptive scale. Their difference is the projection-by-scale-regime interaction. The incumbent need not be surpassed; no favorable interaction or uniform Logloss change is assumed.

Contemporary full bridge should reproduce incumbent AUC/Logloss under the frozen seed and recipe. A mismatch warrants an execution audit and conditional attribution, not a new scientific mechanism claim.

New diagnostics should show zero same-state product/logit discrepancy, zero masked mass and empty summaries, finite inverse-norm statistics and subgroup counts. These first-512 candidate-authored measurements cannot establish population calibration, actual gradients, causality or relevance.
falsifiers: Failure of unchanged-method/constructor/source audit or disagreement with declared same-state forward/VJP algebra invalidates intended intervention isolation. Do not repair this by changing the protocol.

If both fixed arms fail to improve their corresponding unscaled historical surrogates, the proposed benefit of this particular 0.2 attenuation is unsupported. One failed scalar does not establish that every constant scale fails.

If fixed tangent matches or exceeds full AUC, a claim that event-dependent inverse scale is necessary is weakened at this recipe/seed. If full still wins, a calibrated/distribution-matched control and repetitions are needed before asserting necessity.

A direction that reverses in later paired seeds weakens repeatability; a contemporary bridge drift, incompatible checkpoint/config identity or failed/unknown execution prevents unqualified historical pooling. Preserve every receipt and do not duplicate unknown-state jobs.

No Logloss improvement, or worse exploratory small/missing groups, falsifies a blanket quality claim even if whole-population AUC improves. No cluster intervals or significance claims can be constructed from available aggregates.
